About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Diep Nguyen, VP Finance here at Customer.io, and I am looking for an Accounting Manager to partner with the Controller on our month-end close and serve as first-level reviewer for the accounting team. We're a global, remote-first, private company built on subscription and usage-based revenue, with a finance stack that includes NetSuite and FloQast, and we use AI throughout the business, including in Finance. Our accounting team covers revenue accounting, close, AP/AR, payroll, and treasury. You'll report to the Controller and work closely with partners in Sales, Legal, IT, People, and Engineering.

What we value

• Ownership — You own a process from source data through the financial statements.

• Curiosity — You keep asking why until you find the system behind the break.

• A data-backed voice — You bring findings and recommendations to business owners with numbers behind them.

• Practical AI use — You apply AI to speed up accounting work, with documented human review.

What you’ll do

• Partner with the Controller on the monthly and quarterly close in FloQast, tracking deadlines and sign-offs, and help shorten the close through process improvements and AI.

• Review and approve journal entries and reconciliations prepared by others on the accounting team, including cash, accounts receivable, prepaids, deferred commissions, fixed assets, accruals, deferred revenue, and payroll liabilities, and propose the bad debt reserve for Controller approval.

• Draft the monthly flux analysis with root-cause explanations for material variances, assemble the close review folder, and support the Controller in the review with the VP Finance and CFO.

• Assist the Senior Revenue Manager with revenue recognition (ASC 606), including deferred revenue, overage accruals, and usage true-ups.

• Review AP, card, and payroll accruals and entries to confirm liabilities are recorded completely.

• Prepare audit schedules for our external auditors and help document and test close controls with the Controller.

• Coach the accountants who prepare the close, and apply AI tools to flux analysis, accrual review, and reconciliation matching with documented human review.

What we're looking for

• 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2 years reviewing the work of others or managing accountants

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field

• Hands-on month-end close experience at a SaaS company, including reviewing journal entries and reconciliations in an ERP such as NetSuite

• Working knowledge of US GAAP for the accounts you will review, including accruals and unrecorded liabilities, prepaids, fixed assets, and payroll and commission liabilities, with specific knowledge of the allowance for credit losses (ASC 326), capitalized sales commissions (ASC 340-40), and the evaluation of errors and their materiality (ASC 250)

• Experience supporting an external audit, including preparing schedules and responding to auditor requests

• A specific example of using AI to make an accounting process or the close more efficient, which you built or deployed, and what it changed

• Clear written and verbal communication with non-finance partners, and the judgment to know when to escalate to the Controller

• Nice to have: CPA license (active or inactive) or a Big 4 or public accounting background; experience with NetSuite, FloQast, and usage-based billing; SOX or internal controls exposure; and remote-first company experience

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $105k–$122k USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• 30-minute video call with a Recruiter

• 30-minute video call with the Hiring Manager

• 30-minute 1:1 video call with a team member

• 60-minute case review and panel interview

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.

About Actian

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.

What You Will Own:

1. Platform Engineering & Architecture

• Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.

• Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.

• Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.

• Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

• Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.

• Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.

• Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.

• Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.

• Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

• Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.

• Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.

• Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.

• Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.

• Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.

• Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

4. Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.

• Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.

• Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.

• Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

5. Team Building & Leadership

• Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.

• Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.

• Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.

• Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:

• Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.

• Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.

• Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.

• Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.

• Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.

• Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.

• Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

Leadership & Experience

• 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.

• At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.

• Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.

• Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.

• A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.

• The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

Technical Expertise

• Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.

• Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.

• Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.

• Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.

• Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.

• Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.

• Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.

• Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

AI-First Mindset

• Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.

• Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.

• Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.

• A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

Leadership Approach

• Strong ownership and execution skills.

About the Role
We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer with 2 to 4 years of experience to design and build production-grade generative AI features that create real value for our users. You will work across the full stack of modern GenAI development from prompt design and retrieval systems to agentic workflows and LLM orchestration.
In This Role, You Will
• Design and build GenAI features including text generation, summarisation, classification, and question-answering systems.
• Build and maintain RAG pipelines using vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector.
• Develop agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestration.
• Integrate LLM APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models into product systems.
• Build evaluation pipelines to continuously measure output quality, reliability, and safety.
• Optimise LLM features for latency, cost, and quality in production environments.
• Work closely with product and design teams to ship GenAI features that are genuinely useful and trustworthy.
• Monitor GenAI features in production for regressions, hallucinations, and unexpected outputs.
You Might Thrive in This Role If You
• Have 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience with at least one year focused on LLMs or generative AI.
• Are proficient in Python and comfortable building backend systems as well as AI pipelines.
• Have shipped at least one GenAI feature in production and can speak to the challenges you solved.
• Think rigorously about output quality and are not satisfied with systems that work in demos but fail in the real world.
• Stay current on the rapidly evolving GenAI tooling landscape and can separate genuine progress from hype.
Bonus If You Have
Experience fine-tuning or adapting open-source LLMs using LoRA or QLoRA.
Knowledge of multi-modal systems including vision-language models.
Familiarity with structured output generation and function calling.
Experience building multi-agent systems with tool use and memory.
How to Apply
Send your resume and a short note about a GenAI system you built and the hardest problem you solved.
Email us at careers@creuto.com with the subject line Generative AI Engineer Application. Apply Now
